info.title: MOX-ADV module API
info.description: Provider-neutral HTTP/JSON adapter for standalone Direct and Metrika modules.

objective.description: Reduce CPA without losing qualified conversions.

200.description: The module completed or returned a partial analysis.

assessment.summary: The supplied evidence is sufficient for analysis.

recommendations.rationale: The goal is collecting qualified conversions.

ContractError.description: The request does not satisfy ModuleRequestV1.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The idempotency key is already bound to a different request.

ModuleRejection.description: The request is valid but blocked or rejected by the module.

ModuleFailure.description: The module failed with a typed result.

connection_id.description: Reference to a connection held by trusted module configuration. It is not a credential.

schema_version.description: Customer input translated to the unchanged internal goal-candidate-v1 only after trusted connection and scope validation.

operation_type.description: High-level typed operation name, never a provider HTTP operation. EXECUTE expresses intent only and is authorized solely by the trusted environment guard.
